name: efficiency-memo
description: EfficiencyMemo is a pnpm monorepo that hosts a unified tool gallery behind a single Next.js shell with Supabase authentication, currently shipping Charger-Reminder for battery tracking and CoreHour for time tracking. The shell discovers new productivity tools at build time through a dynamic feature registry under apps/web/src/features. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
